originalGoalSummary: Ontology-constrained dynamic read-only analysis MVP: the LLM proposes typed semantic goals and controlled analysis steps; the server deterministically compiles only registered READ capabilities into a read PlanGraph v2 plus a separate registered-operator AnalysisPlan, executes offline (FakeGateway) through a new DynamicReadCoordinator reusing PlanExecutor, and returns evidence-grounded facts with semantic/capability gaps. Legacy four tools, WRITE governance, and existing execution paths must not regress. C0 (design only) precedes any C1/C2 build; C3 chat integration is excluded from this batch.

items.name: semantic-release-asset-pipeline
items.goals: Publish one deterministic, content-hashed SemanticRelease v1 package that binds the existing registrySnapshotId (4 legacy source documents, old paths untouched) to a new semanticSnapshotId covering all semantic assets the new path consumes: MM minimum object keys/scopes (object-types), the first allowlist of analysis-legal Fact field mappings, the registered analysis operator catalog (select_fields, filter_eq, group_sum, compare), and Definition/caliber applicability declarations. Provide build, validation, and cache binding with reproducible, timestamp-free artifacts.
scope: New ontology assets: object-types.yaml (MM minimum object set), analysis-operators.yaml (4 registered operators)
Fact field analysis-allowlist mapping grounded in ontology/fact-types.yaml (existing three READ facts only)
Selective consumption of definitions.yaml / object-links.yaml / business-rules.yaml by the new package; legacy RegistrySnapshot source set unchanged
SemanticRelease v1 versioned contract + JSON schema; semanticSnapshotId digest over expanded source set incl. compiler/operator implementation version digests
Deterministic build/check entry point and snapshot association/correlation checks
nonGoals: No goal interpreter, resolver, compiler, coordinator, or runtime execution
No changes to the legacy registrySnapshot computation or existing snapshot consumers
No hand-writing derivable edges back into relation files
No new supply/demand/ATP formulas; proposed definitions are not promoted to grounded
No Neo4j/GraphDB/OWL reasoner, no new SAP executor family
acceptanceScenarios: Changing any consumed semantic source (asset, mapping, operator definition, bound implementation) changes semanticSnapshotId; identical inputs byte-for-byte reproduce the package
Legacy registrySnapshotId and the four legacy tools remain compatible; old snapshot consumers are untouched
Reference existence validation and business-validity validation produce distinct validation states
SemanticRelease carries both registrySnapshotId and semanticSnapshotId and their association is verified at compile/execute time by C2
openspec validate --strict and ontology bundle check pass; no derivable edge is authored into catalogs

items.name: ontology-goal-read-analysis
items.goals: Provide the goal-first dynamic read-only analysis path: fake GoalInterpreter + model adapter interface, strict SemanticGoalDraft v1 validator, GoalResolver and deterministic SemanticCompiler reusing the producer index and dependency derivation, independent AnalysisPlan v1 with registered operators only, TypedFact/AnalysisResult v1 contracts, TypedFactNormalizer, four deterministic analysis operators with single Python authority, DynamicReadCoordinator over the existing PlanExecutor with FakeGateway, and a Python contract/CLI entry emitting full execution evidence.
scope: Versioned schemas: semantic-goal-draft, read-analysis-plan, typed-fact/analysis-result (SemanticRelease schema belongs to C1)
agent/sap_nexus_agent/ontology_planning/ new package (contracts, interpreter seam, resolver, compiler, validation, fact_normalizer, analysis_runtime, cli)
Reuse semantic_planning graph/derivation and PlanGraph v2 compiler primitives via wrappers; legacy entry points preserved
TS dynamic-analysis coordinator + python-analysis-adapter reusing agent-runtime-adapter subprocess pattern; only existing GatewayClient executes SAP calls
Offline eval cases and holdout harness surface; WRITE/gap rejection before Gateway
nonGoals: No DSH chat registration or shipped UI (C3, separate workstream, not in this batch)
No SAP live connections and no paid model calls; default fake interpreter + FakeGateway
No dynamic WRITE, approval bypass, saga/compensation, ad-hoc capability registration
No LLM-authored SQL/SPARQL/code/expressions; no open operator plugin; no unbounded replanning
No changes to CompositionCoordinator, Java Gateway/bindings, Harness main loop, or SemanticTool v2 contract
No Python/TS dual implementations of analysis math; no replenishment formula reuse without verified caliber
acceptanceScenarios: Q1 inventory+base unit and Q2/Q3 PO grouping/filtering compile to materially different legal read+analysis plans without question-specific recipes

Q5 (arrivals next week) and Q6 (stockout certainty) return semantic/fact gaps; order quantity is never presented as arrival quantity or ATP; Q7 WRITE is rejected before any Gateway call (zero WRITE calls, including nested/disguised attempts)
Missing required values trigger CLARIFY; zero producer -> CAPABILITY_GAP; multiple producers never auto-pick list order

Group sums preserve per-row lineage; missing unit blocks quantity aggregation; duplicate row identities are reported, never silently deduped; truncation marks incomplete and aggregates are not reported as complete
Plan execution pins one SemanticRelease; in-flight runs never mix releases; plans are server-owned records
Holdout question variants pass without business-code changes; legacy four-tool regression suite passes

excluded: C3 sandbox chat integration, live SAP smoke, paid-model evaluation (requires separate authorization)
Cross-domain expansion, shared identity/tenant governance, WRITE governance workstreams
